setup.heading: Tell candidates who you are
setup.subheading: This appears on every vacancy you post. You can change it any time.

logo.label: Logo
logo.hint: PNG or SVG, square, up to 2 MB.

fields.name: Company name
fields.aboutHint: Two or three sentences. Candidates read this before they read the role.
fields.aboutUkPlaceholder: Наприклад: Ми допомагаємо талановитим українським студентам із малозабезпечених родин вступати до найкращих навчальних закладів світу — і підтримуємо їх на шляху додому.
fields.aboutEnPlaceholder: e.g. We help talented Ukrainian students from low-income families win scholarships to the world's best schools — and support them on the way back home.
fields.sectorsHint: Pick up to 3. This is one of the signals we use to match candidates.
fields.emailHint: Where we email you about applications to your vacancies.

dashboard.welcomeDescription: Here's what's happening with your roles.

pending.heading: {{name}} is on review
pending.description: We check the first vacancy from every new company. It goes live within one working day.

incomplete.heading: Finish your company profile
incomplete.description: Candidates read it on every vacancy. Once it's filled in, you can post vacancies and see candidates.

profile.heading: Company profile
profile.description: This block appears on every vacancy you post.

preview.heading: How candidates see you
preview.description: A preview of the company block on your vacancy card.

vacancies.heading: Vacancies
vacancies.description: Everything you've posted, in one place.

empty.heading: No vacancies yet
empty.description: Post your first role and it will reach candidates whose profile matches what you're looking for.

close.heading: Close this vacancy
close.description: One question before it comes down. We use this to see whether Back2Impact actually gets people hired — and to report it back to the partners funding the platform.

reasons.hired_elsewhere: We hired someone, but found them elsewhere
reasons.paused: Still hiring — just pausing the ad

reopen.heading: Reopen vacancy
reopen.description: {{name}} will accept applications again. Everything else stays as it is.

extend.heading: Extend vacancy
extend.description: Pick a new deadline for {{name}}. Everything else stays as it is.

delete.heading: Delete draft
delete.description: {{name}} will be deleted for good. This can't be undone.

candidates.heading: Candidates
candidates.description: Everyone who applied to your roles, with their match score.

empty.heading: No candidates yet
empty.description: When someone applies to one of your vacancies, they'll show up here.

notFound.heading: Nobody matches
notFound.description: Try a different search or status.

dialog.statusHint: Only you see this. The candidate is told when you invite them, mark them hired, or close their application.

statusChange.emailDescription: We'll email this to {{name}} and show it in their Back2Impact account. There's no messaging inside the platform yet — they'll reply to you directly.
statusChange.messageHint: Edit freely — this is a starting point, not a template you have to keep.
statusChange.replyToHint: The address they will write back to.

invited.heading: Invite {{name}} to interview
invited.messageDefault: Hi {{name}}, thank you for applying to the {{vacancy}} role. We'd like to meet you. Could you share a few times that work for you next week?

hired.heading: Mark {{name}} as hired
hired.messageDefault: Hi {{name}}, we're glad to let you know that we'd like you to join us in the {{vacancy}} role. Congratulations! We'll be in touch shortly about the next steps.

not_a_fit.heading: Not a fit for this role
not_a_fit.description: {{name}} will see this application marked as closed in their account. Being told is better than being left waiting.
not_a_fit.sendNoteHint: we'll email a brief, neutral message on your behalf.
not_a_fit.note: Add a line of your own
not_a_fit.notePlaceholder: Optional. One sentence on what didn't match is worth a lot to someone job hunting.

role.heading: The role
role.description: What the job is called and what it involves.
role.title: Job title
role.titleUkPlaceholder: Наприклад: Менеджер із фандрейзингу та партнерств
role.aboutHint: Responsibilities, the experience you're looking for, how the team works. Don't add links or emails here — candidates apply through Back2Impact.
role.aboutEnPlaceholder: What will this person do day to day?

matching.heading: Matching
matching.description: These answers decide who sees this role and what match score they get. Fill them all in — an untagged field lowers the score for everyone.
matching.sectorsHint_one: Pick up to {{count}}. Pre-filled from your company profile — change it if this role is different.
matching.sectorsHint_other: Pick up to {{count}}. Pre-filled from your company profile — change it if this role is different.
matching.spheresHint: Optional. Candidates can filter vacancies by it.
matching.regionHint: Where in Ukraine the person needs to be.

requirements.heading: Requirements
requirements.description: Shown on the vacancy card. Not part of the match score for now.
requirements.seniorityHint: A range means candidates at either level won't be filtered out.

salary.heading: Salary and dates
salary.description: Roles with a salary range get noticeably more applications.
salary.deadlineHint_one: Up to {{count}} day. You can extend or close the role at any point.
salary.deadlineHint_other: Up to {{count}} days. You can extend or close the role at any point.

attachments.heading: What candidates send you
attachments.description: Applications land in Candidates. We'll also email you when someone applies.
attachments.coverLetterHint: ask candidates to explain why they're a fit.
attachments.portfolioHint: useful for design, content and research roles.
attachments.emailHint: Where we email you about applications to this role. Pre-filled with your account email.

settings.heading: Settings
settings.description: Your account and what we email you about.

whenApplies.label: When someone applies
whenApplies.hint: Applications always appear in Candidates, whatever you choose here.

also.label: Also email me when
also.emailWhenVacancyPassesReview: A vacancy passes review and goes live
also.emailWhenVacancyIsAboutToExpire: A vacancy is about to expire — 3 days before it closes
also.emailWeeklySummary: Weekly summary of views and applications

inbox.heading: Where applications go
inbox.description: Add a shared inbox if more than one person handles hiring. This is how a second recruiter sees applications until we add multiple logins.
inbox.label: Additional email

delete.title: Delete company account
delete.hint: Permanently removes your company profile, vacancies and applications. This can't be undone
